meaning:
πρό-κειμαι
[in LXX: Exo.39:18 (36), Num.4:7 (פָּנִים), etc. ;]
used as pass. of προτίθημι;
1. to be set before one, to be set forth: Heb.6:18 12:1-2, Ju 7.
2. to present oneself, be present: 2Co.8:12 (see Mey., in l).†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.
that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope…
Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh…
